route_title: 29-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 defect-cavity DBR with cavity-thickness optimization
compilation_rationale: Bounded 29-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 stack compiled with fixed 9+9 mirror layers and optimizable 11-layer cavity. Three transmittance objectives enforce the peak and dual stopbands. Coherent smatrix solver handles normal-incidence propagation. Uncertainty defaults to 1% relative thickness tolerance.
